presented_output_b: Enable Secure Review in Settings. Secure Review checks new uploads but does not inspect existing files. Keep Secure Review enabled to check future uploads.

judgment.preference_evidence: Both share the same critical instruction change, but B more clearly connects continued enablement to future uploads.
